name: miyabarrier-monorepo
description: Block sales pitches, bots and AI-driven form spam with one script tag.

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run build --workspace @miyabarrier/core && npm run build --workspace @miyabarrier/widget && npm run build --workspace @miyabarrier/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/widget/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dashboard/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
